TERMINAL — built out. Desktop and mobile, same content, filters work: click --all / --work / --study and the list actually filters.

STILL NEEDS YOUR INPUT — everything in [BRACKETS]:
· [COMPANY] — where you've been the last year
· 3 x [PROJECT NAME] + [TECH] — the work projects (set to "private" links; say if any are public)
· [YOUR MAIN STACK] and the second about paragraph
· [YOUR LINKEDIN URL] — the current site still has the literal placeholder in it
· [WHAT YOU'RE PICKING UP NOW] — the learning card

The three university projects are filled in with their real data and links.

The accent colour is one tweak chip above each artboard — green, blue, amber or pink. It recolours everything at once.

Desktop and mobile are separate files, so change it on both.

A — MISSION CONTROL (not chosen)

Kept the space identity but disciplined it: near-black, a faint technical grid, monospace data labels, a telemetry strip.

B — EDITORIAL (not chosen)

Warm paper, serif headlines, work as big numbered entries with room to explain them.

C — TERMINAL (chosen)

This is the original sketch, kept for reference. The built-out version is on the Portfolio page.
